common_contradiction.log_form: Writing U_C=-log(x_C), U_G=-log(x_G), U_T=-log(x_T)>0, each U is the absolute difference of the other two.
common_contradiction.ordering_argument: If M is the largest of the three positive U values, its required equality to the absolute difference of the other two is strictly less than M, a contradiction.
common_contradiction.vanishing_consequence: Because Q, lambda, and 1-lambda are positive, F=H=0 forces y=x*z or z=x*y in each of C,G,T.
